findings.title: Unauthorized fallback gains an unintended login action
findings.detail: The previous no-session branch rendered only the authorization status and detail. Passing kind="permission" without an explicit action to SurfaceState activates that primitive's default loginUrl() CTA ("登录并查看"), adding navigation behavior outside a behavior-preserving state migration. Suppress the default action explicitly or use a primitive variant whose semantics preserve the original no-action state.

checks.name: static behavior and semantics review
checks.result: FAIL: authority dispatch and state text are preserved, attribution/accent branches and responsive primitive styles are coherent, but the permission primitive adds a login CTA absent from the baseline

residual_risks: Static review did not provide browser, runtime, or release proof.
The error primitive changes the prior role=status announcement to role=alert; this is semantically reasonable for an error state but was not verified with assistive technology.
